scientific_question: Does sensitivity-matched precision preserve the successful dense temporal directions while materially reducing their persistent storage?

interpretation_contract.mechanism: Allocate precision according to measured optimizer sensitivity: floating-point momentum protects Muon's polar direction, while full-support int8 feedback preserves the less-sensitive accumulated correction.
interpretation_contract.pass: A hybrid arm meets the unchanged raw and polar gates while using at most 38% of dense FP32 state. Select the smallest passing arm and authorize only its exact-resume implementation plus systems gates.
interpretation_contract.fail: No hybrid meets both direction and storage gates. Close direct reduced-precision storage and do not launch LM training.
interpretation_contract.control: FP16 for both families tests the direction floor but exceeds the 38% storage ceiling and therefore cannot itself be selected.
interpretation_contract.boundary: A pass remains a terminal state-only result. Actual loss, peak VRAM, transient allocation, throughput, and exact resume must be measured after implementation.
